title: Microsoft AppContainer isolation
claim: AppContainer can isolate credentials, devices, files, network, processes and windows using least-privilege resource grants.
limitations: No AppContainer implementation was built or tested here; window isolation means generic app automation cannot simply run inside the same restricted worker.

title: Microsoft Job Objects
claim: Job Objects manage process groups/resource limits and termination; process security limits must be set individually on modern Windows.
limitations: A Job Object is not by itself a full filesystem/network sandbox; child-process/breakaway behavior must be tested.
